reason: I already stop at a supermarket on my way home from work, and the dekkene owner in my village is my neighbour and lets me pay at the end of the month. Why would I give that up to hand a stranger my list and pay cash at pickup?
objection: I get credit at the dekkene and I already pass the supermarket every day, so a $2 fee per bag to pick up what I could buy myself on the way home makes no sense when money is this tight.
would_change_my_mind: If they showed me, with receipts, that my usual items come out clearly cheaper than the supermarket shelf even after the $2, and let me pay at the end of the month like the dekkene does.
